verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a company-formation SaaS, so user-defined event-triggered automation is a plausible capability to ask about, but the evidence pack shows none. The only automatic behavior is Atlas itself filing 83(b) elections and obtaining EINs as part of its own service. That is not a user-defined rule engine.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
